meta.title: After the first bid a vendor column appears with rank and amounts

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Assert that the comparison grid with the submitted bid rendered.
Verify exactly one vendor column appears and uses a real company name.
Verify the displayed quantity matches the API-held bid quantity.
Verify the first bidder is ranked 1.
Verify the per-unit RFQ rate matches the API-held bid price.
Verify the displayed RFQ amount matches the API-held bid total.
Verify the Final section's Sum Total matches the API-held bid total.
Verify the amount equals rate multiplied by quantity and the Sum Total equals the line amount.
cross-check: the screen must show the value the API holds
